title: NEGBINOM: two percentages that name no surface, and one witness with no count
status_plain: W109 established that the negative binomial does NOT inherit the binomial route: it was raced at 10.4% and Loader's dnbinom was refuted at 8.4%. Neither sentence names a surface -- NEGBINOM.DIST or NEGBINOMDIST -- and the banked corpus line reads only "NEGBINOM 1,800". The evidence available points at the LEGACY spelling, since the cached oracle shard for this lane is the NEGBINOMDIST one, but the source does not resolve it and neither does this record. NEGBINOM.DIST's own evidence is one witness with no count. NEGBINOMDIST's own per-surface count, 7 of 138, is recorded on EV-DIST-0012.

counts.ambiguity_note: A percentage with no numerator, on an unnamed surface. It is a candidate-route score establishing that the binomial route does not carry over. It may not be resolved onto the modern surface.
counts.source_sentence: (iii) NEGBINOM does NOT inherit (10.4% raced) -- own route hunt.

counts.ambiguity_note: A candidate-model refutation score, no numerator, no named surface.
